description: Cortex hooks. They need the `cortex` CLI on your PATH (npm i -g @dinacode/cortex) and a linked project (cortex link). Everything is guarded so a missing CLI never breaks your session.

hooks.command: command -v cortex >/dev/null 2>&1 && cortex hook-capture --platform claude || true
